entries.description: Reviewed the accepted app-proof, distributor, and multi-organization baselines plus the remaining downstream Phase 2 specs through a routed analysis pass to confirm that the e2e-workflow-design set still matches the current queue and proof posture.

Created docs/planning/e2e-workflow-scope-ledger.md to freeze the representative-only Playwright inclusion rules, the existing browser-proof baseline, the Session 2 scope themes, and the no-downstream-spec-change verdict for Session 1.

Created docs/planning/e2e-workflow-traceability-rules.md to capture the layer-ownership matrix, required workflow-record fields, and the navigation, validation, multi-organization, and backend-truth traceability rules for later sessions.

Updated docs/session-sets/e2e-workflow-design/spec.md to record that the downstream Phase 2 queue remains sequential and that only disjoint intra-set workflow drafting becomes safe after the Session 1 scope ledger and traceability rules are frozen.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln. The standard build remained blocked by file-lock contention against running AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api and AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web binaries, and the full test run also reproduced existing Playwright HTTP 500 failures on representative app routes including /, /customers, /products, /products/catalog, /admin/users, and /admin/security rather than exposing a Session 1 documentation regression.

Ran mandatory external session verification for Session 1 using the Session 1 spec excerpt, the new scope-ledger and traceability-rule artifacts, the updated activity log, and the build/test evidence from the current repo state.

Created docs/planning/e2e-representative-workflow-catalog.md to expand the seed mini-workflow into a repo-specific candidate catalog, freeze the approved five-workflow Playwright subset, and ground the chosen scenarios in the current admin, shell, orders, and product browser surfaces rather than generic future routes.

Captured the representative invalid and edge branches inside docs/planning/e2e-representative-workflow-catalog.md, including scope-loss on admin/users, direct-route denial after an organization switch, out-of-scope order denial, and one narrow add-product validation path while explicitly deferring report workflows and deeper order-detail mutations.

Created docs/planning/e2e-layered-coverage-matrix.md to map active-organization scope, auth, admin actions, product mutations, orders journeys, validation, and keyboard behavior across unit or integration, bUnit, Playwright, and later UAT ownership.

Created docs/planning/e2e-playwright-implementation-handoff.md to freeze implementation order, seed-data prerequisites, verification helpers, and scope guards for the downstream e2e-workflow-implementation session set.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln. The solution build still hit existing file-lock contention against running test and app binaries including Dabbler.Components.Tests, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright, and SampleApp.Api. The test run partially completed but reproduced the existing AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests HTTP 500 guardrail failures on HomePage_RendersInsideMainShellAndIncludesDabblerAssetAsync, BackofficeAdmin_RouteAccess_MatchesFocusedAdminNavigationAsync, SystemAdmin_RouteAccess_IncludesSystemAdminDestinationsAsync, and AuthenticatedOrganizationSwitch_UpdatesShellAndAdminScopeAsync rather than exposing a Session 2 planning-doc regression.

Ran mandatory external session verification for Session 2 using the Session 2 spec excerpt, the new workflow-catalog, coverage-matrix, and implementation-handoff artifacts, the updated activity log, and the current build/test evidence.
